summary: University of Groningen, The Netherlands, PhD candidate in Natural Language Processing, expertise in functional programming (Haskell, Prolog), strong interest in meditation and Buddhist philosophy, advocates for social welfare systems, critical of US socio-economic conditions, engaged in open-source software development, frequent user of GitHub, enjoys reading and discussing programming languages and paradigms, has a preference for high-quality, lossless music formats, values daily meditation practice, and has a critical view of corporate control over software ecosystems.
